title: Verify: Lockfile root phaser specifier unit tests
summary: Unit test reads real lockfile and asserts root specifier
description: Write tests that read the real package-lock.json and package.json from disk and assert the root phaser specifier.
acceptance_criteria: Test fails when lockfile root says ^4.2.1.
Test passes with ~3.90.0 equal to package.json.
technical_constraints: Alias Node URL as in tests/phaserDependency.test.ts; only filesystem reads of repo files, no network

steps.action: Create the file with readFileSync + fileURLToPath(new NodeURL('../package-lock.json', import.meta.url)) helpers and a test 'root phaser specifier is ~3.90.0 and equals package.json' asserting lock.packages[''].dependencies.phaser toBe '~3.90.0' and toBe pkg.dependencies.phaser.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserLockfile.test.ts -t 'root phaser specifier'
steps.expected: Test fails before ACT1 (^4.2.1) and passes after
